analysis_unit.uncertainty: episode resampled within task; both windows and all checkpoints retained

fusion.product: normalize the coordinatewise product of checkpoint probabilities
fusion.nested_dirichlet: map each fixed-budget evidence vector to a subjective opinion and compose recursively with the manuscript operator
fusion.hierarchy_matched_cautious: coordinatewise minimum of canonical conjunctive log weights within registered pairs, addition across pairs, then one normalization
fusion.pact_registered_family: coordinatewise evidence meet within each registered pair and evidence sum across the four pairs
fusion.random_pairings: all 105 unlabeled partitions of eight checkpoints into four pairs

ready_admission.technical_eligibility: all eight checkpoint outputs present and finite; no additional semantic verifier
ready_admission.ties: analytic proportional inclusion within a tied score group; no record-id tie break

family_partition_test.primary_statistic: mean within-pair phi minus mean between-pair phi
family_partition_test.null_policy: report the null; family registration remains a conservative accounting policy, not an empirical dependence certificate
